description: Self-hosted enterprise config server for OpenCode V2 (WIP). A friendly web UI to manage the whole corporate setup: opencode.json, TUI plugins, agents, skills, commands, env vars and companion tools with their own config (e.g. Hindsight). Served via /.well-known/opencode; employees just use an API key or user/password.
